item.title: Uber rival inDrive eyes 2027 robotaxi tests in Central Asia with Pony.ai and Nvidia
item.dc:creator: Jagmeet Singh
item.description: inDrive plans to begin testing Pony.ai's robotaxis in Kazakhstan's capital in the first half of 2027.

item.title: Left alone with nothing to do, AI agents started playing
item.dc:creator: Aditya Mehta
item.description: MIT researchers marooned 13 AIs on a virtual island, and they responded by inventing games, mourning a lost ring and, eventually, getting better at their jobs.

item.title: OpenAI working on new $30B raise at $1.25T valuation ahead of IPO
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort
item.description: Should OpenAI command an over $1 trillion valuation with this round, it would break records as the most highly valued private company ever.

item.title: 1Password launches a way for AI agents to log in on your behalf without seeing your password
item.dc:creator: Lucas Ropek
item.description: The new feature allows agents to log into a customer's personal accounts while still protecting the private credentials that secure those accounts.

item.title: Canva releases its first image generation model
item.dc:creator: Ivan Mehta
item.description: Canva is making its new image model available to all users, promising better, more customizable performance at lower costs.

item.title: OpenAI makes its Jev competitor widely available as decision model competition heats up
item.dc:creator: Tim Fernholz
item.description: OpenAI is launching its decision model to the world. Can it compete with the original Jev?

item.title: Microsoft’s Mustafa Suleyman says its AI outperforms doctors on hard cases as he chases ‘medical superintelligence’
item.dc:creator: Rebecca Bellan
item.description: Microsoft’s new AI diagnostic system beat generalist doctors on hard cases, according to a study in Science. But most of the improvement seems to come from the AI models underneath, not from Microsoft’s system itself.

item.title: Chinese hackers spied on thousands of companies after breaching IT giant ConnectWise
item.dc:creator: Zack Whittaker
item.description: Microsoft points the blame for ConnectWise's breach at a China-aligned hacker, which relied on AI agents to rapidly hack into thousands of its customers.

item.title: Uber puts all 30,000 employees on ChatGPT Work
item.dc:creator: Lucas Ropek
item.description: The ride-share giant previously deployed a much smaller pilot for ChatGPT Work but is now taking the enterprise agent company-wide.

item.title: Spotify’s current AI bet is about being the music service that agents choose
item.dc:creator: Lauren Forristal
item.description: Spotify co-CEO Gustav Söderström explains why the rise of AI agents could be good news for the music service.

item.title: Claude Duet app is Anthropic’s bet on agents
item.dc:creator: Ivan Mehta
item.description: Claude Duet is available through waitlist for Pro and Max plan users.

item.title: Nirva raises $33M for a pendant that only listens to you
item.dc:creator: Ivan Mehta
item.description: Nirva will ship its $249 ambient AI pendant by the end of the year.

item.title: DeepSeek reportedly raises $15B days after US restrictions
item.dc:creator: Kate Park
item.description: DeepSeek has reportedly raised $15 billion in one of China's largest funding rounds, just days after the U.S. ordered federal agencies to remove its technology over national security concerns.

item.title: Blackstone’s Jas Khaira says fears over AI-buildout debt are overblown
item.dc:creator: Marina Temkin
item.description: Blackstone’s AI head on why the PE giant isn't panicked by market jitters.

item.title: Meta wants to pay for its broad AI buildout with a newly created class of stock
item.dc:creator: Lucas Ropek
item.description: The social media giant is planning a new stock strategy to help power its broad investments in AI models and services.

item.title: TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026: Everything you need to know
item.dc:creator: TechCrunch Events
item.description: TechCrunch Founder Summit is a full-day gathering in Boston on November 4 where founders across all stages connect with top VCs and experienced entrepreneurs to gain tactical insights on building and scaling their companies.

item.title: Meta says Muse has over 10M users, with shopping a top activity
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Meta Muse users are adopting the app for shopping and personal productivity, the company said during its Q3 earnings call. The AI app now has over 10M users.

item.title: Recursive launches Flint, a laptop coding model it says was largely built by AI
item.dc:creator: Aditya Mehta
item.description: Startup Recursive has released Flint, a free, laptop-sized coding model built largely by its own AI research system, as an early test of AI that improves itself.

item.title: While Amazon blocks AI agents, Walmart rolls out the welcome mat
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: As Amazon blocks AI agents from shopping on its site, Walmart is taking the opposite approach, introducing new technology that lets AI agents make purchases on customers' behalf, with controls over spending and transaction approvals.

item.title: PHP Armageddon: OpenAI, Google’s Wiz find ancient holes, panicking the internet
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort
item.description: This is the kind of security issue that was found and prevented by AI, but is also a high risk because of AI.
